title: 한국해양소년단연맹 육성에 관한 법률 / queue:ADDENDUM:04541:19930306:00003:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDA (Government Organization Act) <Act No. 4541, March 6, 1993>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Act shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. <Proviso omitted>

Article 2 Omitted.

Article 3 (Amendment of Other Acts Following Establishment of the Ministry of Culture and Sports) (1) through (10) Omitted.

(11) The Act on the Fostering of the Korea Sea Explorers Association is partially amended as follows:

In Articles 6 through 10, "Minister of Sports and Youth" shall be replaced with "Minister of Culture and Sports".

(12) through (35) Omitted.

Articles 4 and 5 Omitted.
